antaiventures-antaiventures:ashbyhq:55b4.title: CTO & Co-Founder - Agentic AI (LegalTech)
antaiventures-antaiventures:ashbyhq:55b4.description: 🌍 ABOUT ANTAI VENTURES Antai Ventures https://antaiventures.com/ is a leading venture studio headquartered in Barcelona, with a strong presence across Southern Europe and Latin America. We team up with exceptional entrepreneurs to build disruptive, scalable companies from scratch. Since 2012, we've co-founded 30+ ventures, including Glovo, Wallapop, PlatanoMelon, and PiperAI. Collectively, our startups have raised over $1.5B in funding, generated $3B+ in shareholder value, and created 5,000+ jobs. 💡ABOUT JURYO https://juryo.ai/ Juryo is building the agentic AI platform for small and mid-sized law firms, starting with high-volume B2C practices (extranjería, LSO, laboral, deudas, civil). Our voice and WhatsApp agents already qualify clients, generate documents, manage cases, and handle billing workflows, delivering over 2× improvement in lead conversion for our customers. We’ve gone from idea to revenue in months: - Multiple paying law firms onboarded - Six-digit ARR - Daily usage (+200 calls/WhatsApps) by real customers - Clear PMF in a massive, fragmented €5B+ market (in Spain alone) As a co‑founder, you’ll be in the driver's seat—shaping the vision, setting the pace, and taking ownership. In return, we’ll back you with capital and provide hands‑on support across Product, Tech, Design, GTM, Legal, Talent, Finance, and Fundraising to accelerate your journey from 0 to 1. 🛠️ WHAT YOU’LL DO - Co‑craft the technical North Star with the founding team and convert vision into an aggressive, value‑obsessed roadmap. - Build hands‑on and ship code daily, leveraging the latest AI orchestration techniques (multi‑agent workflows, toolformer, dynamic RAG pipelines) and rock‑solid engineering practices (DDD, SOLID, ruthless automation) to deliver customer value at record speed. - Recruit, coach, and scale a top‑1 % engineering guild spanning backend, frontend, data, and DevOps—shipping product that customers actually use every single week. - Design high‑throughput data pipelines to improve our agents while guaranteeing security and compliance. - Drive a culture of excellence through continuous delivery, rapid experimentation, and metrics‑driven improvement. - Move fast, obsess over customer impact, and work tirelessly to turn an ambitious vision in reality. 🔍 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer - Hands‑on builder. You prototype quickly and turn ideas into working features in days. - Practical AI experience. You’ve built with modern LLM tools—agent orchestration, RAG, embeddings—and know what works in production. - Curious and smart. You track new research and apply what’s useful. - User‑value focus. You measure success by customer impact and time saved, not vanity metrics. - Ownership mindset. You take responsibility for outcomes and think long‑term about product and company value. - Bias for shipping. You pick simple solutions, automate routine tasks, and release early and often. - Team builder. You attract and develop strong engineers and foster a supportive, high‑standards culture. - Clear communicator. You explain technical trade‑offs to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders. 🤝 WHAT WE OFFER - Day‑1 founding seat. Jump into an ambitious startup from the ground up, with a validated concept and live pilots. - De‑risked upside. Build as a co‑founder on a path charted by Antai’s successful venture‑studio model—capital, playbooks, and network included. - Full‑stack operator support. Access Antai’s expert teams in Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Legal, Talent, and Fundraising whenever you need them. - Significant equity. Own a sizable stake in this venture and optional carry in other Antai portfolio startups. - Founder community & investors. Join a tight network of serial entrepreneurs and top‑tier backers who’ve scaled category leaders. - Workspace flexibility. Work from our hubs in Barcelona, Madrid, or Mexico City—or stay remote and sync on frequent on‑sites.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:fd1.description: Backcountry Outlet is a new retail division built on a simple idea: expert gear guidance paired with accessible pricing. It’s a place where seasoned skiers, first-time mountain bikers, and families alike can confidently gear up for what’s next. Our stores are powered by Gearheads who live the lifestyle—skiing, riding, hiking, and climbing—and bring that credibility to every customer interaction. This isn’t transactional retail; it’s about connecting people to the right gear, providing expert ski, snowboard, and bike services, and creating a reason to come back. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. As a Seasonal Custom Boot Fitter at Backcountry Outlet, you’ll be responsible for delivering top-tier, personalized ski and snowboard boot fitting services. You’ll work hands-on with customers to assess fit issues, perform custom modifications, and ensure every skier or rider leaves with boots that enhance comfort, control, and performance. This role requires both technical skill and a passion for helping people get the most out of their time on snow.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5ebd607f-95a9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Video Annotation & Data Labeling Specialist based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of next-generation AI models through high-quality video data annotation. You will analyze video content, segment sequences, label observable actions, and verify AI-generated descriptions for accuracy. No previous professional experience is required, making this an accessible opportunity for candidates who are detail-oriented and eager to learn. You will receive structured training and certification before progressing to paid production work. Consistent, high-quality performance can provide priority access to more advanced and higher-paid AI data projects. The role is designed for reliable contributors who can follow precise guidelines and maintain strong accuracy across large volumes of annotation tasks. Write objective, concise 1–2 sentence summaries of video sequences using simple and accurate English. Segment videos into clearly defined, action-based sequences without gaps or overlaps. Label and describe only actions that are directly and visually verifiable in the video. Use simple present tense and consistent terminology when creating annotations. Review AI-generated captions and identify or correct inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unclear descriptions. Follow project-specific annotation guidelines precisely to ensure consistency across datasets. Maintain a high level of accuracy and productivity while completing assigned annotation batches. Complete the required onboarding and certification activities, including reviewing guidelines, practicing with the annotation platform, and successfully completing five certification tasks. Apply feedback from quality reviews to continuously improve annotation accuracy and consistency. Requirements No previous professional experience in data annotation or AI is required; beginners are welcome. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify specific actions and events in video content. Ability to describe only what is visibly observable without making assumptions, interpretations, or unsupported conclusions. Strong written English skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and objective descriptions. Ability to consistently follow detailed instructions, annotation guidelines, and quality standards. Commitment to maintaining a target benchmark of 95%+ accuracy . Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage repetitive tasks while maintaining accuracy and focus. Ability to learn new annotation tools and workflows quickly. Reliable availability for 25–40 hours per week for long-term data annotation projects. Willingness to complete an approximately 3-hour certification and onboarding process before entering paid production work. Benefits Compensation of $2.00–$5.00 , depending on verified quality and productivity. 25–40 hours per week of dedicated, long-term data annotation opportunities. No prior professional experience required, with beginners encouraged to apply. Structured onboarding, training materials, and practical experience with an annotation platform. Certification process designed to prepare contributors for paid production work. All certification hours are paid once you begin performing production tasks. Priority access to advanced and higher-paid projects based on successful performance. Opportunity to gain practical experience contributing to AI model development and verification. Long-term project opportunities for consistent, high-quality contributors. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8896fafc-306b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll help teams improve throughput, collaboration, and delivery predictability while proactively managing risks and issues. Identify project risks and issues proactively, develop mitigation and contingency plans, and help teams resolve obstacles efficiently. Apply Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and other appropriate project management practices to improve transparency, collaboration, and team throughput. Demonstrated experience managing technical teams, particularly software engineering and quality assurance teams, and a strong understanding of software development lifecycles. Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize competing demands, work independently, and maintain strong organizational discipline. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to identify issues, manage risks, and drive timely resolution. Experience mentoring teams and helping them adopt or improve Agile methodologies and practices. Hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira and Airtable. Strong understanding of the life insurance and annuity industry is preferred. PMP, Scrum, SAFe, or other relevant project management certifications are a plus. Ability to work remotely i

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bd7dfda9-2895-.title: Data Scientist - Finance AI & Analytics
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bd7dfda9-2895-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Scientist - Finance AI & Analytics based in United States. This is an opportunity to join a high-impact Finance AI & Analytics team focused on turning complex business data into actionable insights. You will develop advanced statistical and machine learning models that help business leaders understand uncertainty and evaluate future scenarios. The role combines hands-on data science, modeling and simulation with strategic business problem-solving at enterprise scale. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, technology teams, and business stakeholders across a complex organization. Your work will directly support better planning, decision-making, and business management through data-driven analysis. The environment values intellectual curiosity, technical rigor, ethical thinking, and practical innovation. This role can be hired at either Level 3 or Level 4, depending on your education and professional experience, with a fully remote option available. Develop statistical and machine learning models using a modeling and simulation approach to quantify uncertainty, evaluate potential outcomes, and support business scenario planning. Translate complex finance and business-management challenges into well-defined analytical questions and determine the most appropriate methodologies to address them. Build clean, well-structured, understandable, and maintainable code that supports collaboration, reproducibility, and successful model deployment. Serve as a trusted technical advisor on data science methodologies, modeling approaches, and technology decisions, while communicating requirements effectively to technology partners. Work collaboratively across multiple teams to deliver analytics initiatives, manage stakeholder relationships, and communicate findings in a clear and actionable way. Mentor junior data science team members by sharing technical guidance, best practices, and approaches to solving complex analytical problems. Stay current with emerging data science, machine learning, and analytics methodologies and identify innovative opportunities to create measurable business value. Contribute to enterprise-level analytics transformation by helping evolve processes, technical capabilities, and data-driven decision-making practices. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related professional experience, Master’s degree with 3+ years, or PhD with 1+ years for Level 3; alternatively, Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years, Master’s degree with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years for Level 4. Deep foundational knowledge of statistical modeling and machine learning concepts, with the ability to select and apply appropriate techniques to complex business problems. At least 4 years of professional experience with Python and strong proficiency in data transformation using SQL or a comparable data-querying language. Experience using version control systems such as Git within collaborative development environments. Hands-on experience with cloud-based data science technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark, or PySpark. Proven ability to translate business challenges into analytical questions, develop data-driven solutions, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and manage relationships throughout complex projects. A degree in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related field is preferred. Experience with Monte Carlo simulation, time-series modeling, probabilistic modeling, productionizing models, executive presentations, or finance/business-management data is highly desirable. U.S. citizenship may be required for positions involving government clearance or other restricted work.

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:16c07f5a-b9e5-439.description: ABOUT US We are a well-funded SF Bay Area startup backed by tier-1 investors. We build developer tools and AI-powered platforms for complex enterprise software (code generation, workflow automation, and enterprise-grade deployments). Join a talent-dense founding team in a technical leadership role with meaningful equity and real growth upside at the intersection of ERP and artificial intelligence. ROLE SUMMARY Define architecture, standards, and deliver solutions end to end. This hybrid, generalist role blends core platform design in cloud (AWS/Azure) data and application architecture with hands on, customer facing delivery. You will lead builds across Node.js services, AI and agent workflows, and integrations with enterprise systems, owning quality and reliability. - Cloud and Systems Design with depth in building secure, scalable systems across networking, autoscaling, multi tenant patterns. Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CDK and strong observability with metrics, tracing, logs, and SLOs. - Application Engineering Strong Node.js and TypeScript for APIs and services. Proficiency with Postgres and experience with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Milvus for retrieval and semantic search. - Experience orchestrating agentic workflows and retrieval augmented generation. Familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. - DevOps and Delivery Solid engineering practices including CI/CD with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, automated testing, code reviews, trunk based development. Comfortable with Docker and modern release management. - Hands on use of AI tools with clear ideas for applying AI to development, testing, data, and support. - Ownership mentality, crisp communication, comfortable deciding with 80 percent information. - Move fast without breaking things, not afraid to learn new stacks, bring a we will figure it out attitude. WHY JOIN - Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy. - High bar for craft, velocity, and pragmatic shipping. LOGISTICS - Total compensation: $240,000 to $400,000 - Base salary: $160,000 to $250,000 plus meaningful founding equity - Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area - Visa Support/Sponsorship available
